prototypeStage: All 28 prototypes visually inspected before starting fine line variants.
linePrompt: Use case: precise image edit, transparent fine-line variant for a night-sky overlay. Trace the supplied approved full-color artwork into a SPARSE, VERY FINE warm-ivory contour drawing. Preserve EXACTLY the same pose, face direction, hair/crown outline, hands, costume silhouette, animals/props, relative scale and 3:4 image framing. Draw clean hairline strokes, about 1 pixel inner lines and 1.5 pixels outer contour at a 1086-pixel width; much finer and lighter than an ordinary bold outline. Keep only the defining facial features, main folds, essential armor seams and a few identifying ornament lines. REMOVE all pigment fills, shading, white paint flakes, abrasion speckles, stippling, hatching and dense ornamental textures. Every interior area between lines must be fully transparent: a face, arm, robe, disc or animal must NOT become an opaque white shape. Single uniform warm ivory #e5ddc9 stroke color. No bloom, glow halo, colored tint, background, black fill, paper, border, labels or stars; luminosity will be applied by the sky renderer. True transparent alpha outside AND inside the outlines. All anatomy is simplified respectful nonsexual cultural-statue contour. Do not add, subtract, move or invent any subject. Keep the complete original framing and exact same 1086x1448 output dimensions.
lineStage: All 28 full-color prototypes were completed and inspected before line variants. Four fine-line pilots were checked in a browser on a dark background before the remaining 24 variants. Source raster pixels are preserved without programmatic edge filtering.
